User Registration: Hash password with bcrypt (12 rounds) before storing
Login: Verify password hash, return access token (15m) + refresh token (7d) as HTTP-only cookies
Auth Middleware: Verify JWT signature, check user exists in DB, validate role permissions
Operator Approval: New operators cannot add buses or schedules until approved by Admin
Create Schedule: Operator must own the bus; route must exist; departure time must be in the future
Search Schedules: Filter by source city, destination city, and journey date; sort by departure time ASC by default
Lock Seats: Seat must be in 'available' state; use DB transaction to prevent race conditions; lock expires in 10 minutes
Create Booking: Seats must be locked by the same user; booking created in 'pending' state
Payment Webhook: Verify HMAC signature; update booking to 'confirmed' and seats to 'booked' on success
Payment Failure: Booking set to 'expired'; seats released when lock timeout is reached
Cancel Booking: Calculate refund percentage based on time remaining before departure; initiate refund via gateway
Ticket Generation: PDF ticket auto-generated on booking confirmed; sent to user's email
Seat Lock Cron: Job runs every 1 minute; queries SeatLocks where expires_at < now(); releases expired locks
Pagination: All list endpoints support page, limit, sortBy, sortOrder query params
Search: Schedules searchable by from, to, date; buses searchable by name, type, bus number
